stories.title: Kenya confirms a second Ebola case, a relative of the first patient
stories.summary: Kenya confirmed its second Ebola infection on Wednesday, identifying the patient as a relative of the first confirmed case. Health teams are widening contact tracing as they try to keep the outbreak from growing.

stories.title: Fire erupts at the Albania education ministry as protests enter a third day
stories.summary: A fire broke out at the Albania education ministry building as demonstrations against the government stretched into a third day. The unrest has become a test of how long the government can absorb public anger.

stories.title: Container ship sinks in the Strait of Hormuz after being struck
stories.summary: A container ship was hit by a projectile and sank in the Strait of Hormuz, Singapore authorities said, the latest vessel lost in the waterway during the Iranian campaign against shipping. The sinking keeps pressure on insurers, shippers and oil markets.

stories.title: US inflation rises more than expected, feeding rate worries before the midterms
stories.summary: Consumer prices rose 3.7 percent in the year to September, faster than forecast and driven largely by higher motor fuel costs. The reading lands weeks before midterm elections and feeds fears that the Fed keeps rates higher for longer.

stories.title: YouTube Music adds AI labels as generated songs flood streaming
stories.summary: YouTube Music is rolling out labels intended to flag AI-generated music as synthetic tracks spread across streaming platforms. The step adds pressure on distributors and labels to disclose how songs were made.

stories.title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to gather fraud intelligence
stories.summary: The startup runs AI agents that pose as targets so scammers expose their playbooks, then packages what they learn as fraud intelligence for banks and merchants. It is part of a broader wave of AI tools aimed at automating scam defense.

stories.title: Mosqitter turns mosquito traps into an AI monitoring network
stories.summary: Mosqitter is adding AI to its traps so they can identify and count mosquito species in real time, turning a pest-control product into a data service. The company pitches the network as a way to spot disease-carrying populations early.

stories.title: Netflix to cut about 1,000 jobs in its steepest reduction since 2022
stories.summary: Netflix is laying off roughly 1,000 employees as it trims costs amid intensifying competition for viewer attention. The cuts show that even the streaming leader is being pressed to tighten spending.

stories.title: Browns pass rush thrives without Myles Garrett as the Ravens loom
stories.summary: Cleveland got to the quarterback using secondary support and crash stunts, spreading the pressure beyond its usual sources. The wrinkle matters with Baltimore up next in an AFC North showdown.

stories.title: Dylan Sampson cleared to practice and could return Sunday against the Ravens
stories.summary: The Browns designated running back Dylan Sampson for return from injured reserve, opening a practice window and giving him a chance to play Sunday against Baltimore. His return would boost a backfield that has leaned on Quinshon Judkins, who is dealing with an ankle injury.

stories.title: Browns run game stalls again ahead of the Ravens test
stories.summary: Cleveland heads into its AFC North meeting with Baltimore still unable to run the ball, with Quinshon Judkins averaging about 3 yards per carry through five weeks. Fixing the ground game is the biggest question for an offense that has depended on its defense.

stories.title: Shedeur Sanders hires the first agent of his NFL career
stories.summary: The Browns quarterback signed with Adie von Gontard of Young Money APAA Sports, according to ESPN, after entering the league without representation. The move comes weeks before the Nov. 10 trade deadline and sharpens speculation about his future in Cleveland.

stories.title: Field Guide: No. 4 Ohio State visits No. 5 Indiana in the Big Ten game of the year
stories.summary: Ohio State travels to Bloomington as a 3.5-point favorite to face an Indiana team on a 22-game win streak, with the Big Ten race and a playoff seed in the balance. It is a rematch of the 2025 Big Ten championship game that the Hoosiers won.

stories.title: The Situational: This One Is Going to Hurt
stories.summary: The long-form preview frames the Indiana rematch around the stakes: a Hoosiers program that beat Ohio State for the Big Ten title last season and has not lost since. Ohio State players have been candid that the loss still stings.

stories.title: Big Ten Power Rankings: Ohio State and Indiana battle for the top spot
stories.summary: Ohio State and Indiana hold the top two spots in this week power rankings ahead of their head-to-head meeting, with Iowa and Purdue making the biggest jumps. The order underscores how much Saturday shapes the conference race.

stories.title: Three things from the Ryan Day week 7 press conference
stories.summary: Day played down revenge talk before the Indiana rematch, said the offensive line has a plan despite personnel shuffles, and expects most of the six starters who missed the Maryland win to return. Ohio State needs those bodies back for its toughest road test so far.

stories.title: Horner says he wanted Alonso and Leclerc at Red Bull
stories.summary: In the run-up to his memoir, the former Red Bull team principal said he pushed to sign Fernando Alonso and Charles Leclerc during his two decades in charge. The admission hints at how different the Red Bull line-up could have looked.

stories.title: Why Horner banned the Mercedes name inside Red Bull
stories.summary: Horner revealed he barred staff from saying Mercedes while Red Bull built its first power unit, using the rival as fuel for the project. That engine programme underpins the team push under the 2026 regulations.

stories.title: Red Bull extends Laurent Mekies contract through 2031
stories.summary: Red Bull signed team boss Laurent Mekies to a deal running to the end of 2031, locking in the man who replaced Christian Horner in July 2025. The extension lands as the team climbs back toward the front after a slow start to the 2026 rules.

stories.title: Brundle calls the Hamilton Singapore strategy call bizarre
stories.summary: Martin Brundle said the strategy that left Lewis Hamilton out of position in Singapore was bizarre, adding scrutiny to Ferrari race operations. Ferrari has already conceded the failed gamble was a misjudgement.

stories.title: Columbus Zoo transfers three manatees for the final stage of rehabilitation
stories.summary: The zoo moved three manatees to partners for release-ready care and took in three more for treatment under a partnership with the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission. The animals are rehabilitated with the goal of returning to Florida waters.

stories.title: Former Catholic Foundation executive indicted in abuse case gets $750,000 bond
stories.summary: A former executive of the Catholic Foundation was indicted in a sexual abuse case and given a $750,000 bond. The Columbus-based foundation manages charitable funds for Catholic donors and parishes across central Ohio.

stories.title: Columbus police search for a 14-year-old girl missing from the west side
stories.summary: Police asked for help finding a 14-year-old girl reported missing from an address on Whitethorne Avenue on the city west side. Investigators are asking anyone with information to come forward.

stories.title: Gahanna Halloween festival returns with hayrides and trick-or-treating
stories.summary: Gahanna is bringing back its Halloween festival with hayrides and trick-or-treating for local families. It is one of the city events filling the calendar this month.
